test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following artificial colouring agents is used in dietary supplements, sauces, soups and broths, bakery, dairy fats and oils, seafood, condiments, breath fresheners, desserts, convenience foods and beverages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Quinoline yellow.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Quinoline Yellow**

__
 
• **Quinoline yellow** can be used** to colour cosmetics, drugs, and food, including dietary supplements, sauces, soups and broths, bakery, dairy fats and oil, seafood, seasonings, breath fresheners, desserts, and convenient foods, and beverages.**
 
• It** occurs as a yellow powder or granules.**
 
• It is manufactured by **sulfonating 2-(2-quinolyl)-1,3-indandione**.
 
• It is added to foods and beverages at concentrations up to a** maximum permitted level (MPL)**.
 
• There are currently **8 food categories for which MPLs for quinoline yellow have been adopted **in the General Standard of Food Additives. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

**Acid Fuchsin​**

 
• **Acid Fuchsin** has been** used in tissue sections for Masson′s trichrome staining.**
 
• It has been used as a marker to trace ingestion of solutions by green peach aphids.
 
• It also works as a** pH indicator.**

**Orange G**

 
• **Orange G** is used in the** Papanicolaou stain to stain keratin.**
 
• It is also **a major component of the Alexander test for pollen staining.**
 
• It is often combined with other yellow dyes.
 
• It is used **to stain erythrocytes in trichrome methods.**

**Oil Red O**

 
• **Oil Red O **is a type of **Sudan lysochromes** that stain lipid and triglyceride contents in frozen liver tissue sections.
 
• This dye is** used for the staining of neutral lipids.**
 
• It is** used to detect latent fingerprints on dry and wet porous items like paper and cardboard.**
